hint.title: How it works
hint.body: Pages are split, the answer key and contents are read and you are asked to confirm the setup; then questions are imported test by test. When it is done you review and approve.

registry.title: Book registry
registry.body: Imported books are added to the book list; you can fix the offset and answer key there.

setup.title: Confirm the book setup
setup.intro: Check the tests, page ranges and answer key. Yellow cells differ between the two reads; type the correct letter. Confirming starts the question import and uses one book from your monthly allowance.
